FN-IN396Z-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 178
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Clyde Chambliss
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/12/2023
Senate Bill 178 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama G.I. Dependents
Scholarship Program paid by the by Education Trust Fund, by an undetermined amount by allowing the
spouses of veterans that were killed or that died while on state active duty status, or whose death results
proximately and within three years from an injury sustained while on state active duty status to be
reimbursed for tuition, books, and fees. The amount of the increase would be dependent upon the
number of eligible spouses of veterans attending the qualifying schools, which would be limited to the
Department of Defense Tuition Assistance Cap (currently $250 per credit hour) and the $1,000 per
semester cap on books and fees and after first applying for other federal, state institutional, and 3rd party
scholarships awarded for the academic year. For fiscal year 2022, the average annual program cost was
approximately $5,700 per student.

FN-IN396Z-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 178
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Senator Clyde Chambliss
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/10/2023
Senate Bill 178 as passed the Senate could increase the obligations of the Alabama G.I.
Dependents Scholarship Program, paid from the by Education Trust Fund, by an undetermined
amount dependent on the cost of education benefits provided to spouses of veterans eligible
pursuant to this bill. Under current law, these benefits are limited to: (1) the Department of
Defense Tuition Assistance Cap of $250 per credit hour, currently; (2) the $1,000 per semester
cap on books and fees; and (3) after first applying for other federal, state institutional, and 3rd
party scholarships awarded for the academic year. For fiscal year 2022, the average annual
amount of educational benefits paid per student was approximately $5,700.
